description.value: A municipal campground on Logan Lake with 50 lakeview sites, flush washrooms, hot showers, and potable water — but only two designated tent sites at $28/night plus a $7 resort fee, so availability for cyclists is tight. Walking distance to trails, disc golf, a bike park, and a waterpark makes it an activity-rich overnight in a small Thompson-area town.

address.value: #1 Opal Drive, Logan Lake, BC V0K 1W0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at loganlake.ca/recreation/municipal-campground/ confirms an active municipal campground with 50 lakeview RV sites and two unpowered designated tent sites, seven potable water taps, hot showers, free internet, and online reservations. The nearby attractions passage explicitly mentions a bike park and multiple hiking/biking trails within walking distance, supporting cyclist relevance. A phone number discrepancy exists: OSM lists +1-250-523-6283 while the website's contacts page lists 250.523.6225 as the main municipal/campground line, so phone confirmation is flagged false.
concerns: Phone number discrepancy: OSM lists +1-250-523-6283 but the website's contacts page shows 250.523.6225 as the primary municipal/campground contact number. The OSM number may be a direct campground line not shown on the website; recommend verification.
No physical campground address in OSM record; address used above is the municipal office address (PO Box 190, #1 Opal Drive) from the website, which may not be the campground's physical location.
Only two unpowered tent sites available (vs. 50 RV sites); capacity for non-RV cycle tourists is very limited.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, actively operated municipal campground with hot showers, potable water, free internet, reservations, and a bike park plus biking trails within walking distance — a clear fit for touring cyclists in the Thompson-Okanagan region.
enrichment_extras.notes: Free internet confirmed on-site. Nearby bike park and multiple hiking/biking trails are within walking distance per website. Camper discount on the adjacent golf course is noted. Shoulder season (post-Thanksgiving to May) has power only; all other amenities including showers are closed during that period.

wow_evidence: hot showers, free internet... bike park and multiple hiking/biking trails within walking distance
